name: Algebra 1 Notes Course Profile
role: Course-specific Notes constants. Framework/Assessment Plan own exact learning; Notes PM owns procedure; template/CSS own shell; approved Bank families supply Example/You Try It question architecture.

assessment_plan_contract.section_learning_rule: Notes use the exact section Learning Target and exact section Intro I Can statements.

bank_relationship.canonical_bank_architecture: Mastery Goal -> exact I Can -> approved Question Family
bank_relationship.example_yti_rule: For every current Intro I Can, resolve the canonical Bank that owns that goal/I Can, including a future mastery Unit when necessary, select an approved instructionally appropriate family, and instantiate a fresh Example/YTI parallel.
bank_relationship.missing_bank_rule: In the completed course state, Example/YTI should not invent an unrelated architecture when the canonical owning Bank is expected. If a staged build intentionally precedes that Bank, fail/flag the dependency rather than silently treating a local question as permanent authority.
bank_relationship.student_label_rule: Show exact I Can code + full exact I Can statement with Example/YTI questions.

visual_contract.workspace: compact Notes workspace appropriate for handwriting/Notability

standard_section_order: Section Preview: What I noticed / What I wonder
I Can compartments in exact Assessment Plan order

example_yti.source: approved Bank family for the exact Intro I Can
example_yti.fresh_instance_rule: Do not copy the Bank exemplar values verbatim by default; use approved variation axes.

wtc.rule: Do not add a WTC section merely because older Notes/Profile versions contained one.

representation_fidelity.hard_rule: When a prompt names a representation, render that representation literally.
representation_fidelity.graph: Actual graph stimulus or actual blank coordinate plane using the registered graph route.
representation_fidelity.mapping: Actual mapping diagram when mapping is the job.
representation_fidelity.ordered_pairs: Tuple/list notation only when ordered pairs are the intended representation/job.
